alt.en: A black-and-white photograph looking down a long cobbled dockside street. On the left, the masts and rigging of many sailing ships crowd the dock behind a long timber shed whose end carries the signs "GEORGE'S DOCK." and "TO THE GEORGES LANDING STAGE". On the right, tall brick warehouses line the street, with rail tracks, horse-drawn carts and people walking.
alt.es: Fotografía en blanco y negro de una larga calle empedrada junto a los muelles, vista desde arriba. A la izquierda, los mástiles y las jarcias de muchos veleros llenan la dársena detrás de un largo cobertizo de madera con los letreros "GEORGE'S DOCK." y "TO THE GEORGES LANDING STAGE". A la derecha, altos almacenes de ladrillo bordean la calle, con vías, carros de caballos y gente caminando.

caption.en: Sailing ships tied up in George's Dock, Liverpool, on a glass stereo slide made between 1860 and 1890: Leave Her, Johnny was sung as a voyage ended, as the ship came into port or once she was tied up.
caption.es: Veleros amarrados en George's Dock, en Liverpool, en una diapositiva estereoscópica de cristal hecha entre 1860 y 1890: Leave Her, Johnny se cantaba al terminar un viaje, cuando el barco entraba en puerto o una vez amarrado.

source: Gezicht op George's Dock in Liverpool (printed title "8382 Les Docks et Liverpool (instantanée), Angleterre"), anonymous photographer, glass stereo slide, 85 x 170 mm; left half of the stereo pair
licenceEvidence: Rijksmuseum's own record (https://id.rijksmuseum.nl/200339619) marks the image "Public Domain", https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/; photographer "anonymous", dated 1860 - 1890. An anonymous photograph of 1890 or earlier: PD by age in the US, the EU and Israel (see rights.md).

alt.en: A detail of an old printed page headed "Across the Western Ocean." in large type, above a paragraph that begins "One of the best known hauling songs is "Time For Us to Leave Her."", with the line "Oh, the times are hard and the wages low," set apart in the middle.
alt.es: Detalle de una página impresa antigua con el título "Across the Western Ocean." en letra grande, sobre un párrafo que empieza "One of the best known hauling songs is "Time For Us to Leave Her."", con el verso "Oh, the times are hard and the wages low," destacado en el centro.

caption.en: W. B. Whall's opening to "Across the Western Ocean" in Ships, Sea Songs and Shanties (third edition, Glasgow, 1913), page 68: he believed Leave Her, Johnny grew from this packet-ship shanty of about 1850, keeping its first line.
caption.es: El comienzo de "Across the Western Ocean" en Ships, Sea Songs and Shanties de W. B. Whall (tercera edición, Glasgow, 1913), página 68: Whall creía que Leave Her, Johnny nació de esta canción marinera de los paquebotes de hacia 1850, de la que conservó el primer verso.

source: W. B. Whall, Ships, Sea Songs and Shanties, third edition, enlarged (Glasgow: James Brown & Son, 1913), "Across the Western Ocean", p. 68, detail (heading and Whall's first two paragraphs)
library: Smithsonian Libraries (digitized by the Internet Archive)
callNumber: Internet Archive shipsseasongssha00whal, scan image n87; Smithsonian Libraries 39088006794259
licenceEvidence: Published Glasgow 1913 (title page "Third Edition. Enlarged", 1913; preface dated November 1910); author William Boultbee Whall 1846-1917. The detail holds only Whall's own prose (none of R. H. Whall's harmonies). US: published before 1931. EU and Israel: life + 70 ended 31 December 1987. Faithful scan of a flat page (see rights.md).
credit: Smithsonian Libraries, via the Internet Archive

alt.en: A printed page of music headed "II. Leave Her Johnny." and "First version.", with a voice part marked Solo and Chorus over a piano part and the first verse, "O the times are hard and the wages low", under the notes. Below, verses 2 to 7 are printed, from "The bread is hard and the beef is salt," to "I will send you money, I will send you clothes." The page number is 3.
alt.es: Página impresa de música con los encabezados "II. Leave Her Johnny." y "First version.", con una voz marcada Solo y Chorus sobre una parte de piano y la primera estrofa, "O the times are hard and the wages low", bajo las notas. Debajo están impresas las estrofas 2 a 7, desde "The bread is hard and the beef is salt," hasta "I will send you money, I will send you clothes." El número de página es 3.

caption.en: Leave Her Johnny as No. II, first version, on page 3 of Cecil Sharp's English Folk-Chanteys (1914): John Short's version, the one we sing, with its seven verses.
caption.es: Leave Her Johnny como n.º II, primera versión, en la página 3 de English Folk-Chanteys de Cecil Sharp (1914): la versión de John Short, la que cantamos, con sus siete estrofas.

source: Cecil J. Sharp, English Folk-Chanteys, with Pianoforte Accompaniment, Introduction and Notes (London: Simpkin, Marshall, Hamilton, Kent & Co. and Schott & Co.; Taunton: Barnicott & Pearce, 1914), No. II, "Leave her Johnny", first version, p. 3
